story.name: My Decade at Aga Khan University: Unveiling the Essence of Growth and Purpose

content.title: My Decade at Aga Khan University: Unveiling the Essence of Growth and Purpose
content.author: Dr. Asad I Mian

content.text: Almost three decades ago, when I took my first step into AKU as a medical student, I had no inkling of the remarkable voyage that awaited me. Upon completion of the Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree, my fascination with human genes and genomes led me to pursue a PhD in molecular and human genetics at Baylor College of Medicine, in Houston, Texas, setting the stage for an awe-inspiring journey of academic exploration and intellectual revelations. During my time at Texas Children's Hospital, I delved into the intricacies of paediatric emergency medicine, gaining a deeper understanding of the management of the acutely/emergently sick or injured child. After fifteen years in the US, I made my way back to my alma mater, this time as a faculty member. It's been ten years and there is so much I've learned along the way.

At AKU, the convergence of passion, profession, vocation, and mission has bestowed upon me a profound sense of purpose. More than just an institution, this was where my contributions found meaning. As a Zalsa trainer, creative, innovator, entrepreneur, author, clinical researcher, and paediatric emergency physician, I have had the privilege of exploring a diverse array of roles that fulfil my multifaceted identity. It is within the nurturing embrace of AKU that I discovered the concept of "ikigai" - reason for being. This institution has been instrumental in nurturing purpose and creativity, empowering me to find fulfilment in both my personal and professional pursuits.

One of the most remarkable aspects of my tenure at AKU has been the opportunity to delve into the realm of I|C|E - Innovation, Creativity, and Entrepreneurship. The organization's support and encouragement has allowed me to explore and unleash my potential in these realms. It is with immense gratitude that I credit AKU for enabling these facets, which have not only enriched my professional journey but have also kindled my spirit to pursue new avenues of growth and impact.

Amidst a demanding career, AKU provided me with the space and encouragement to focus on my wellbeing. As a remedy for physician burnout, I embarked on a journey into Zalsa - a unique fusion of Zumba and Salsa. This invigorating workout routine not only revitalized my physical health but also nourished my soul, providing a healthy escape from the challenges of everyday life. AKU's holistic approach to wellbeing has played an instrumental role in helping me strike a balance between my professional commitments and personal wellness. More importantly, I was able to teach and train others in Zalsa and thus improve their physical and mental wellbeing too.

As I pen these reflections on my decade at AKU, I am overwhelmed by the beauty of life's journey. Each step, each decision, and each experience has woven a unique verse in the symphony of my life. In tandem, I extend heartfelt gratitude to my family for their support and love, their belief in my dreams has been an unwavering source of strength. With a profound sense of purpose and love, I embrace the years to come, knowing that what lies within me is the driving force that shapes my path.
"Carpe diem - seize the day. Make your lives extraordinary."
I invite all who read this to seize the day, embrace their passions, and create extraordinary lives filled with purpose and love.
Thank you, Aga Khan University, for being the foundation upon which my transformative journey thrived, and to all who have played a part in this enriching chapter.
